Dear Norvane Controls S.r.l. team,

We regret to inform you that the PM-88 shipment, originally due 27/11/2026, is being held at Genoa customs for a documentation check.

**Expected delay:** 9 days
**New estimated arrival:** 06/12/2026

We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience this causes to your planning. We will notify you through the Kestrel customer portal as soon as customs releases the shipment.

Yours faithfully,
Li Wei Chen
Account Manager, Kestrel Components
